articles.summary: KEY HIGHLIGHTS LuxExperience1 with strong top-line growth: Net Sales increased +8.5% ex-FX (+9.6% reported at €610.5 million) in Q1 FY27 vs. Q1 FY26 Strong 430bps improvement in Adjusted SGA cost ratio: Decreased from 21.8% in Q1 FY26 to 17.6% in Q1 FY27, highlighting continued Adjusted SGA reductions Significant Adjusted EBITDA profitability expansion: Adjusted EBITDA Margin improved by 590bps to 2.1% in Q1 FY27 vs. -3.9% in Q1 FY26 Accelerated outstanding top-line performance across all segments: Net Sales ex-FX increased by +10.0% for Mytheresa, +7.2% for NAP MRP and +8.2% for YOOX in Q1 FY27 vs. Q1 FY26 Significantly improved Adjusted EBITDA profitability across all segments: More than doubled Adjusted EBITDA at Mytheresa, continued positive Adjusted EBITDA at NAP MRP, and more than halved Adjusted EBITDA loss at YOOX in Q1 FY27 vs. Q1 FY26 Raised FY27 guidance: LuxExperience increased its FY27 Adjusted EBITDA Margin guidance to 2.5% to 3.5% (prior: 2% to 3%)
articles.title: Q1 FY27 Results: LuxExperience with strong Net Sales growth of +8.5% ex-FX (+9.6% reported) and significantly improved Adjusted EBITDA profitability across all three segments in Q1 FY27 vs. Q1 FY26; Raising FY27 guidance
